title: Engraving alignment trial
passage:
Woman: Before we choose a guide for lining up the engraving on our aluminum tags, take a look at the trial sheet. The machine does the engraving either way. What changes is how the operator lines up each tag.
Man: The new guide looks good on the flat tags. Is this everything we ran?
Woman: Everything we finished. We also set aside six curved tags during the new-guide run. The first operator couldn't get them to sit flat. They were never engraved, so they're not on the sheet.
Man: That matters. The curved-tag orders are all short runs with different names. When people switch names, they have to lift the tag and line it up again. Flat tags can be left in a row while the machine moves from one name to the next.
Woman: For next week's order, I need a method for flat tags only. We're doing them in sets of ten. I'd rather avoid redoing tags than save a bit of setup time.
passageZh:
女：在決定用哪種定位治具來對準鋁製牌片上的刻字位置之前，先看一下試作紀錄表。不管用哪種，刻字都是同一台機器負責；差別在於操作人員怎麼對準每一片牌片。
男：新治具在平面牌片上的表現看來不錯。這是我們試做的全部嗎？
女：是已完成的全部。用新治具試做時，我們還另外擱下六片弧形牌片。第一位操作人員沒辦法讓它們平穩貼合。那六片沒有刻字，所以沒列在表上。
男：那很重要。弧形牌片訂單都是小批量，而且刻的名字各不相同。換名字時，操作人員必須拿起牌片，再對準一次。平面牌片則可以一排放好，讓機器依序刻上不同名字。
女：下週的訂單只需要處理平面牌片。我們會每十片分成一組。我寧可少重做一些牌片，也不想只省那一點準備時間。
